USAGE
  losat <COMMAND>

DESCRIPTION
   Pure-Rust pairwise alignment that matches NCBI BLAST+ on LOSAT's test fixtures, with genetic-code exceptions

Commands:
  blastx       Translated nucleotide query vs protein subject (blastx)
  blastn       Pairwise nucleotide alignment (megablast [default], blastn, dc-megablast, blastn-short)
  blastp       Pairwise protein alignment (blastp)
  tblastx      Pairwise 6-frame translated nucleotide alignment (tblastx)
  tblastn      Protein query vs translated nucleotide subject (tblastn)
  psiblast     Position-Specific Iterated BLAST (psiblast)
  deltablast   Domain Enhanced Lookup Time Accelerated BLAST (deltablast)
  rpsblast     Reverse Position Specific BLAST (rpsblast)
  rpstblastn   Translated Reverse Position Specific BLAST (rpstblastn)
  makeblastdb  makeblastdb: create a BLAST database from a FASTA file (format version 5 by default, 4 with -blastdb_version 4)
  rpsbproc     Process output from offline rpsblast to annotate sequence with conserved domain information (rpsbproc; its domain hits, sites and motifs of protein and nucleotide queries)
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -help     Print help
  --version  Print version



Other programs (losat <program> -help shows each one's options):
  blastdbcmd                  BLAST database client
  dustmasker                  Low complexity region masker based on Symmetric DUST algorithm
  segmasker                   Low complexity region masker based on the SEG algorithm
  windowmasker                Window based sequence masker
  convert2blastmask           Convert masking information in lower-case masked FASTA input to file formats suitable for makeblastdb
  makembindex                 Create a BLAST database index.
  makeprofiledb               Application to create databases for rpsblast, cobalt and deltablast
  blastdb_aliastool           Application to create BLAST database aliases
  blastdbcheck                BLAST database integrity and validity checking application
  cleanup-blastdb-volumes.py  Remove needless BLAST database volumes.
  blast_formatter             Stand-alone BLAST formatter client, version LOSAT 0.2.0

To call the programs by NCBI's names (blastn, makeblastdb, ...), link them with:
  losat -install-shims [DIR]   (default: the directory of this executable)
